page.content:
The Attorney was an attorney for InGen. He helped Peter Ludlow sign contracts granting him ownership of his uncle's company as a result of InGen Corporate Resolution 213C.

page.overview:
Who is Attorney?

The Attorney was an attorney for InGen. He helped Peter Ludlow sign contracts granting him ownership of his uncle's company as a result of InGen Corporate Resolution 213C.
